name: Harmonic predictions for tertiary amines monomers, monohydrates and dihydrates
description: Harmonic predictions using B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-TZVP for the monomers, monohydrates and dihydrates of 12 tertiary amines: trimethylamine (MMMN), N,N -dimethylethylamine (MMEN), N,N -dimethylisopropylamine (MMIN), tert-butyldimethylamine (MMTN), N,N -dimethylcyclohexylamine (MMCN), N -methylpyrrolidine (MN4), N -methylpiperidine (MN5), quinuclidine or 1-azabicycloocatane (N555), 1,2,2,6,6-pentamethylpiperidine (MN5MMMM), triethylamine (EEEN), N,N -diisopropylethylamine (IIEN) and triisopropylamine (IIIN). For each system, xyz.file, output.file, inp.file and hess.file are provided.
